transcription.transcribed_from: Table 1 of the source publication (PMC6188666), read by hand; the list is not published in any machine-readable form and no API serves it
transcription.transcribed_by: Claude Opus 5 assisting the BH26 project, 2026-09-15
transcription.machine_steps: Only the GRCh38 coordinates were machine-resolved: each hand-entered CAID was looked up in the ClinGen Allele Registry (reg.genome.network)
transcription.verification: Gene symbol and transcript HGVS returned by the registry were compared against the hand-entered row for the eight substitutions. The ACAD9 duplication was checked against the Ensembl GRCh38 reference sequence at 3:128879640-128879660 before anchoring and left-aligning it
transcription.re_verify_when: The source table, its transcript versions, or the registry mapping changes. Re-read the published table before trusting this list in clinical use

ba1_exceptions.note: Nine variants from Table 1 of the source publication, each resolved to a GRCh38 allele through its ClinGen Allele Registry CAID. Transcript HGVS was cross-checked against the registry for the eight substitutions; the ACAD9 duplication was anchored and left-aligned from the registry's genomic interval.

variants.resolved_by: ClinGen Allele Registry duplication interval NC_000003.12:g.128879648_128879651dup, anchored and left-aligned against the Ensembl GRCh38 reference base at 3:128879647
variants.note: Published as c.-44_-41dupTAAG; the registry records the same allele as c.-44_-41dup
